prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the edit target. Preserve the same pictured subject and realistic photographic style; correct only the specified framing or leaf anatomy. Maintain a genuinely transparent PNG background.
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: one standalone professional image for an Arabic family visual guessing game (age 16+).
Subject: a wooden rocking chair side view.
Style: realistic high quality photography with correct anatomy and object geometry, clean natural textures.
Composition: landscape 4:3, the complete subject occupies only the central 55% of the frame, leaving at least 20% completely transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides; centered with ample margins, immediately recognizable when revealed.  
Background: genuinely transparent background with alpha channel; isolated cutout; no shadow backdrop; no checkerboard; color subject will become a silhouette inside the game.
Constraints: exactly the stated subject; no label, caption, watermark, collage, borders or readable words.  Do not create a black silhouette; render the full natural-color cutout with transparent surroundings. Output must be a PNG cutout with actual alpha=0 pixels outside the subject, fully transparent canvas. Do not paint white, gray, black or checkerboard behind it. Keep the entire outline visible. Natural color, no ground plane or cast shadow.

Required correction:
Correct the framing: show the complete wooden rocking chair in side view, including the backrest top, all legs, both complete curved rockers and their front and back tips. Keep the whole outline centered in the central 55% of the canvas with broad truly transparent padding on all four sides. Nothing may touch an edge. Preserve natural full color and genuine transparent alpha; no floor or cast shadow.

question.q: ما اسم المقعد ذي القاعدتين المنحنيتين في هذا الظل؟
